option_relations.rationale: Chronic actinic dermatitis (actinic reticuloid) is a distinct condition from Actinic pseudolymphoma, although both are related to light exposure. The biopsy findings of nodular lymphocyte infiltrate with germinal centers are more characteristic of pseudolymphoma than typical chronic actinic dermatitis.

Actinic prurigo with associated cheilitis is a distinct condition from Actinic pseudolymphoma. While both are light-induced, the histological findings described (nodular lymphocyte infiltrate with germinal centers) are not typical for actinic prurigo.

Polymorphic Light Eruption (PMLE) is a distinct condition from Actinic pseudolymphoma. While both are light-induced, the histological findings of a nodular lymphoid infiltrate with germinal centers are not characteristic of PMLE.

Polymorphous light eruption is a distinct condition from Actinic pseudolymphoma. While both are light-induced, the histological findings of a nodular lymphoid infiltrate with germinal centers are not characteristic of polymorphous light eruption.
